rules.name: Project activation gate
rules.description: A project must be reviewed and approved before it can be activated.

rules.name: Single accountable role
rules.description: Each activity must have exactly one Accountable role in the RACI matrix.

rules.name: Checklist sign-off gate
rules.description: An inspection checklist must be reviewed and approved before the related activity can be closed.

rules.name: Controlled document version
rules.description: Only approved documents become the controlled version available for download.

rules.name: Planner sync window
rules.description: Planner synchronization runs only within the configured sync window and must reconcile mapped activities.

rules.name: Template versioning
rules.description: Templates must be versioned before reuse on a new project.

rules.name: Vendor approval gate
rules.description: Vendors must be approved before assignment to a project.

rules.name: Notification throttling
rules.description: Duplicate notifications must be throttled within a five minute window.

rules.name: Workstation completion gate
rules.description: A workstation activity cannot be closed until its inspection checklist is complete.

rules.name: User activation prerequisite
rules.description: A user account must have a role assigned before access is activated.
